name: Dungekon Online
summary:
Dungekon Online is an idle action RPG that lives in a thin strip at the bottom of your screen. Your hero walks through dungeon stages and fights on their own, so it can keep running while you do other things.

Loot drops in rarities from Common up to Primal, with named uniques that change how your abilities work. Gems, corruption and a workbench let you keep improving gear you like. Your stash and life skills are shared across all your heroes.
